map.：gamma = tau / G。剪应力 tau=10MPa、G=77GPa 时: : gamma = tau / G. With shear stress tau=10 MPa and G=77 GPa, gamma is about 1.3e-4 (radians). Shear strain is a dimensionless angular deformation.
map.：小变形时 gamma≈tan(φ)≈φ（弧度），是直角的改变量。: : For small deformation gamma≈tan(φ)≈φ (radians), which is the change of a right angle.

map.剪应变单位？: What Is the Unit of Shear Strain?
map.无量纲（弧度，因是长度比长度）。工程上直接以弧度表示直角变化。: Dimensionless (radians, since it is a ratio of lengths). In engineering the change of a right angle is expressed directly in radians.
map.剪应变和正应变区别？: What's the Difference Between Shear Strain and Normal Strain?
map.正应变是伸缩（长度变化率），剪应变是角度畸变（直角改变）；分别对应法向与切向载荷: Normal strain is stretching (a rate of length change) while shear strain is angular distortion (a change of a right angle); they correspond to normal and tangential loads respectively.
